description: Frozen inputs for the model-evaluation and benchmark-matrix figure. The cell-level sweep supplies target IoU and source-compliance state for every configuration in the matrix — the original generation and the later extension run under the same protocol. The economics record supplies the corresponding median API-list-price-equivalent cost, computed by data/agents/paper_swap/build_compilation.py against the sourced rate card. The iterative API record is retained as provenance for the historical comparison in the surrounding prose and is not rendered here.
